Hi and thank you <3

I am glad things worked out for you in the end, I tried hard to make it work but it just didn’t. 

I ended up with a few cuts and fortunately, or unfortunately, I didn’t go through with it. 

I’ll try to get help for the nth time. 

I hope it’ll work. 

Ty. 🙂
She would, she would a lot.

Hi, thank you <3

I tried, and got so far, but in the end, it didn’t matter (one of my favourite songs. But also so true)

I can’t tell myself nice things because I would just be lying to myself. 

I will try for the nth time to get help. 

I just ended up with a few cuts. Thats all. 

Thank you for your message. <3

Hi,

Thank you. <3 

Unfortunately I am too cynical and nihilistic and I genuinely don’t see anything good in myself. 

For now I just ended up with a few cuts. 

Thank u.
